Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double is 216. Hold Alt, type 216 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double also has the Unicode codepoint U+256A, so you can type it with Alt+9578 on Windows, search for U+256A in macOS's Character Viewer, use ╪ in HTML, or \256A in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ╪ or the hex escape ╪.

How to type box drawings vertical single and horizontal double on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 1 6 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double character (╪) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type box drawings vertical single and horizontal double on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double" and click the character to insert it.

How to use box drawings vertical single and horizontal double in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\256A"; ()
  • Python: \u256A or chr(0x256A)
  • JavaScript: \u256A or String.fromCodePoint(0x256A)
  • JSON: "\u256A"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double?

The legacy Alt code for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double is 216. Hold Alt, type 2 1 6 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ╪ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ╪, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9578 not work?

Alt+9578 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double?

The Unicode codepoint for Box Drawings Vertical Single And Horizontal Double is U+256A. You can use this value in HTML as ╪, in CSS as \256A, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ╪ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+256A, then click it.
